title: Verdant Eternity Band
metal: rhodium silver tone (PVD rhodium over surgical stainless steel), bright high-polish mirror finish
lock: An open-back adjustable band in bright rhodium silver tone, about 16.5mm inner: about 11 oval green cubic zirconia, 5 x 4mm, each in 4 claws. Across the front about 6 ovals alternate either side of 1 slim scalloped S-wave of tiny clear pave; toward the back the ovals sit in plain claws on scalloped bare metal, and the gap ends in 2 open looped tips. Must stay 1 single S-wave cupping each oval on one side only, never a straight row of ovals and never a full pave halo around each oval.
morph: The single scalloped S-wave of clear pave between the green ovals: image models straighten it into a row of ovals beside a pave line (b02-5 failure) or close it into a full pave halo around every oval (b01-3 failure). Second risk: the word 'eternity' pushes the open back with its 2 looped tips into a closed full-eternity ring.
sizeMm: Inner diameter about 16.5mm at rest (US 6), open back adjusts about 15.7 to 18.9mm (US 5 to 9) per the listing size guide; oval stones about 5 x 4mm. Band height not listed: estimated about 6mm from the worn photo, where about 5 green ovals span the top of an index finger (about 1.8cm), each oval about a third of the nail width.
claims: Waterproof, Tarnish Free, Hypoallergenic (all three are tags; the description also says 'Waterproof and tarnish free' and 'PVD rhodium coating, anti-tarnish'). Adjustable (tag) fits US 5 to 9.
copyNotes: Use: 'green cubic zirconia', 'clear pave', 'rhodium silver tone', 'PVD', 'adjustable, fits US 5 to 9', 'open back', 'waterproof', 'tarnish free', 'hypoallergenic', 'surgical stainless steel'. Avoid: 'emerald' in any form as a stone (including 'emerald-green cubic zirconia'; the listing's own stone note says 'not emerald'), 'diamond'/'eternity diamond', 'gemstone', 'sterling silver', 'white gold', bare 'silver' or 'gold', 'full eternity' or 'stones all the way round' (the back is open), 'one size fits all' (it is US 5 to 9).
story: A green-and-white heirloom look (the emerald-and-diamond wave band of a grandmother's jewellery box) in cubic zirconia at Rs 1,049, adjustable so it is a safe gift without knowing her size. The pave line weaves like a vine or a river between the green stones. It rhymes with wedding-season green: mehendi, green silk, festive evenings, and works as the single colour break in a stack of plain cool-toned bands (the listing's own styling tip). Earlier best archetypes: occasion (mehendi/wedding), green colour camp, stack with plain bands, day/night.
variants: One variant only: Default Title, rhodium silver tone, stock 58. Every ring photo shows this variant. Listing media: 01 on a plaster cube from above (whole ring, front S-wave and the back ovals); 02 worn on the index finger at the lips (scale, about 5 ovals across the finger); 03 upright on a plaster cube (clearest whole construction, both looped tips of the open back); 04 the blush Naira Petite gift box (no ring); 05 size guide card (16.5mm inner, US 5 to 9). Show 03 as the construction authority and 01 for how the ovals alternate either side of the wave.
